Subject: Proposal: split demo to capture CTO's 30-minute window and shift deep-dive

Hi Jaspreet / Allison —

Thanks for the heads up about Jaspreet's transit window. I heard he only has a ~30-minute open slot on Monday morning when he lands. Rather than push the whole session and risk losing executive time, I propose we split the meeting into two connected blocks so we can:

- Cover the high-level product walkthrough and key ROI points in a tight 30-minute segment that aligns with Jaspreet's window.
- Schedule a follow-up 60-minute technical deep-dive later the same day for Allison and the engineering reviewers (Soojin to lead).

Attached: demo-runbook.pdf (walkthrough script) and revised-agenda-v2.docx (proposed split timing).

Questions / asks:
1) Can Jaspreet confirm he can join Monday 11:00–11:30 PT for the exec portion?
2) If yes, would Acme prefer the deep-dive the same afternoon (I suggested 15:00–16:00 PT) or later in the week?
3) Marissa / Soojin / Markus — can you confirm who will present each segment and who will be on the technical Q&A?

If we can lock the 30-minute window, I will update the calendar invite and send a concise 1-page agenda for the exec slot so we respect Jaspreet's time.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop

Lauren —

Thanks for proposing a split. I can't be in a two-hour block; I only have a hard 30-minute window on Monday 11:00–11:30 PT when I'm between flights. That slot works for a succinct exec-level walkthrough and a few targeted questions. Allison will join as well.

Please keep the exec portion strictly focused — top 3 value points, one live demo highlight, and an ask at the end. If you need a quick pre-brief call with me beforehand to set expectations (10 min), I can do 10:30–10:40 PT.

All —

Thanks, Jaspreet — confirmed for 11:00–11:30 PT. A couple of logistics from our side:

- Exec segment (11:00–11:30): Lauren will open with a 6–8 minute outcomes/ROI framing, then I'll do a tight 12–14 minute live product highlight (focus on latency/cost savings + routing/fallback), leaving ~4–6 minutes for Jaspreet Q&A. We'll keep the demo script trimmed to two scenarios (hosted API flow + dedicated fallback).
- Deep-dive (15:00–16:00 PT): Soojin will lead architecture, kernel/quantization discussion, and run through an integration checklist for Acme's infra. I'll join for product questions and Markus will be there for any SLA/fallback escalation items.

I've attached revised-agenda-v2.docx with the minute-by-minute breakdown and a one-page exec brief we can send to Jaspreet ahead of time. I'll also prune slides to a single demo VM live flow for the exec session.

Next steps:
- Lauren: please send the updated calendar invites with 11:00–11:30 exec invite and the 15:00 deep-dive. Add the one-page brief to the exec invite.
- Soojin: please confirm you can run the deep-dive at 15:00 PT and post the technical pre-reads to the shared drive.

   - Lead: Soojin Lee (soojin.lee@redwood.com) — architecture, kernel selection, quantization notes, integrations checklist
